description: One standing forecast: the odds Frontier Desk gives every path at the dates it is scored on, the readings behind them, the scenarios with the markers that say which one we are on, and when it is next rescored. Where the report has an odds panel and names how its odds were made, odds_are quotes that in the report's own words. Odds are the desk's own; they are not a market price and nothing settles them but the dated public sources each report names. The whole report is on its page.
